LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.NoQuality: Off: this item has no quality.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.ParticipationO: Off: quality effects are switched off for this item.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.GlobalOff: Off: this effect is switched off in the Effects tab.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.RecordedBlock: Off: this effect is blocked for this item.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.AdapterOff: Off: this effect cannot work in this game.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.Candidate: On. Applies whenever the item uses this stat.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.NativeInformat: Stats the game already scales with quality
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.NativeUncertai: These stats already change with quality in the base game or another mod, and this mod leaves that alone. The list covers every loaded stat, not only the ones this item uses, and may miss mods that work differently.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.ProviderPolicy: Keep skipping items that supported mods already handle
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.PolicyHelp: When on, every game start adds an Off exception for items that supported mods handle themselves. Exceptions you already have are kept. Turning this off does not remove exceptions that were already added.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.PolicyPreview: These items are handled by other mods you have loaded. While this is on, each game start gives them an Off exception if they don't have one. Save and restart to apply.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.RecoveryPrevie: Bring back these per-item choices from an older version of the mod as item exceptions. Existing exceptions for the same items are replaced. You can undo this, and nothing is saved until you save.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.LegacyPreview: Per-item choices kept from an older version of the mod.
LanguageData.QEverything.Compatibility.ProgressionSum: The Progression preset shows its changes before applying. Details for this game are below; mods that are not listed are not handled specially.
